entities.name: Macri Era and Return to the IMF
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Mauricio Macri (Cambiemos coalition) won in 2015 as the first non-Peronist/non-Radical elected president in decades. He liberalized the economy, settled with holdout creditors, and obtained a record $57 billion IMF loan (2018), but rising inflation and peso devaluation eroded his support.
